content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the Jamia Hamdard Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download Jamia Hamdard Guest/ Visiting Faculty Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Guest/ Visiting Faculty: B.E./ B.Tech./ B.S. and M.E./ M.Tech./ M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in relevant branch with First Class or equivalent in any one of the degrees OR B.E./ B.Tech. and M.C.A. with first class or equivalent. National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by UGC/ CSIR or similar test like SLET/ SET/ GPAT/ GATE. Ph.D. Degree in relevant discipline and teaching experience in Basics of Python Programming, Basics of Computer Sciences, AI and Machine Learning (ML) and Data Analytics is preferred.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Jamia Hamdard Guest/ Visiting Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Jamia Hamdard for filling temporary teaching positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by Jamia Hamdard?
faq.answer: The advertised post name is Guest/Visiting Faculty under advertisement number FR - 13/2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Guest/Visiting Faculty position in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection mode for Jamia Hamdard Guest/Visiting Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection mode is directly through a Walk-in-Interview without any prior written exam application.

faq.question: Q5. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or MCA with NET/SLET/SET/GPAT/GATE along with preferred Ph.D. qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Jamia Hamdard Guest/Visiting Faculty?
faq.answer: The salary and remuneration are provided strictly as per Jamia Hamdard university norms.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry to the interview venue?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring prescribed application format, detailed CV, original educational certificates, experience certificates, testimonials, and self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location is New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110062 at Jamia Hamdard campus.
